piece.idea: When an AI app millions of people loved goes bust, who walks away with the money?
piece.thesis: Character.AI went bust on 12 October. Google had already paid a reported $2.7 billion to use its technology and hired its founders. Disney is offering jobs to some of its staff, and the lawsuits stay with what is left.
piece.body: Character.AI went bust on 12 October. The money had already followed the people.
